description: This file defines the initialization functions and related types for neural network parameter initialization in PyTorch's C++ API, including functions for setting tensors with specific distributions and calculations related to layer initialization.

methods.name: calculate_gain
methods.description: Returns the recommended gain value for a specified nonlinearity function.

methods.name: constant_
methods.description: Fills a tensor with a constant value in-place.

methods.name: dirac_
methods.description: Fills a tensor with the Dirac delta function in-place.

methods.name: eye_
methods.description: Fills a 2D tensor with an identity matrix.

methods.name: normal_
methods.description: Fills a tensor with values from a normal distribution.

methods.name: orthogonal_
methods.description: Fills a tensor with an orthogonal matrix.

methods.name: sparse_
methods.description: Fills a tensor with a sparse matrix pattern.

methods.name: uniform_
methods.description: Fills a tensor with values from a uniform distribution.

methods.name: kaiming_normal_
methods.description: Fills a tensor with Kaiming normal initialization.

methods.name: kaiming_uniform_
methods.description: Fills a tensor with Kaiming uniform initialization.

methods.name: xavier_normal_
methods.description: Fills a tensor with Xavier normal initialization.

methods.name: xavier_uniform_
methods.description: Fills a tensor with Xavier uniform initialization.

methods.name: _calculate_fan_in_and_fan_out
methods.description: Calculates the fan-in and fan-out for a tensor.
